맛.e: 맛있다 = delicious ('taste exists'); 맛없다 = not tasty.
맛.t: 맛이 is pronounced [마시]. 맛있다 is [마싣따] (also accepted: [마딛따]).

계획.x: Do you have any plans this weekend?
계획.t: Usually pronounced [게획] or [게훽]: 계 is commonly said like 게.

계속.forms: 계속 + verb: 계속 비가 와요 · verb: 계속하다 (to continue)
계속.x: It's been raining nonstop since morning.
계속.e: Both parts mean 'continue'. 계속 가세요 = Keep going.

노력하다.m: to try hard, to make an effort, to strive
노력하다.ex: 한국어를 잘하고 싶어서 매일 노력하고 있어요.
노력하다.x: I want to be good at Korean, so I'm working hard at it every day.
노력하다.t: For 'try to do', use -(으)려고 노력하다: 일찍 자려고 노력해요 = I try to go to bed early.

선택하다.x: Please choose just one of the two.
선택하다.e: Two syllables that both mean 'pick', doubled.

과장.x: Sorry, but the manager is in a meeting right now.
과장.e: Literally 'section head'. A homonym 과장 (different hanja) means 'exaggeration'.

과장.ex: 그 광고는 제품의 효과를 너무 과장했어요.
과장.x: That ad greatly exaggerated the product's effects.
과장.t: Homonym: 과장 (課長) is a section manager at a company.

서명.ex: 이 서류 맨 아래에 서명을 해 주세요.
서명.x: Please sign at the very bottom of this document.
서명.t: In everyday speech people usually say 사인 instead: 여기 사인해 주세요.

회복.ex: 수술 후 회복이 빨라서 정말 다행이에요.
회복.x: It's a real relief that the recovery after surgery has been fast.

존경.x: That teacher is respected by the students.

문학.ex: 저는 한국 문학에 관심이 많아서 소설을 자주 읽어요.
문학.x: I'm very interested in Korean literature, so I often read novels.
문학.t: Pronounced [문학]: the ㅎ is kept in standard pronunciation.

주장.x: That person's claim has no basis.

변경되다.m: to be changed, to be modified
변경되다.x: The meeting time has been changed to 3 p.m.
변경되다.t: 변경되다 is formal, typical of notices; in everyday speech, 바뀌다 is more common.

발명.x: The invention of the telephone changed the world greatly.
발명.t: 발명 is creating something new; 발견 is discovering something that already exists.

교양.m: culture, refinement; general education, liberal arts
교양.ex: 대학교 1학년 때 교양 수업을 많이 들었어요.
교양.x: I took a lot of general-ed classes in my first year of college.
교양.e: Literally 'teaching and nurturing': cultivating the mind.
교양.t: 교양 있다 = cultured, well-mannered; in college, 교양 means general-ed courses outside your major.

추측하다.ex: 저는 그의 표정을 보고 결과를 추측했어요.
추측하다.x: I guessed the result from the look on his face.
추측하다.e: Literally 'infer and measure': reasoning your way to a guess.
추측하다.t: Pronounced [추츠카다]: ㄱ plus ㅎ becomes ㅋ.

좋아요.ex: 제가 올린 사진에 좋아요 좀 눌러 주세요.
좋아요.x: Please like the photo I posted.
좋아요.e: The polite form of 좋다 'to be good', used as a noun for the 'like' button.
좋아요.t: Pronounced [조아요]. Like a post is 좋아요를 누르다; 좋아요 수 = number of likes.

돗자리.x: We spread a mat on the grass in the park and sat down.
돗자리.e: Native word; originally a mat woven from rush stems. 자리 means 'mat, seat'.
돗자리.t: Pronounced [돋짜리]: ㅅ sounds like ㄷ and makes the next ㅈ tense. Spreading one is 돗자리를 깔다; Han River parks fill with them on warm evenings.

수당.x: If you work on weekends, you get extra pay.
수당.e: Came in via Japanese; its characters (hand + apply) don't explain the meaning.

교육열.x: In Korea, parents are extremely passionate about education.
교육열.t: Pronounced [교융녈] — an ㄴ is added before 열, then ㄱ nasalizes.

내려받다.ex: 자세한 내용은 홈페이지에서 파일을 내려받아 확인하세요.
내려받다.x: For details, download the file from the website and check it.
내려받다.e: 내리다 'to bring down' + 받다 'to receive': a native replacement for 다운로드.
내려받다.t: Common in official notices and news; in conversation people mostly say 다운받다.

적극성.ex: 회의에서 자기 의견을 말하는 적극성이 필요해요.
적극성.x: You need the initiative to share your opinions in meetings.
적극성.e: Literally 'piling up to the extreme' — going all in.

덤벙대다.forms: 덤벙대요 · 덤벙댔어요 · 덤벙댈 거예요 · 덤벙대지 마세요
덤벙대다.m: to act rashly, to be careless and hasty
덤벙대다.x: Don't rush — read the question slowly.
덤벙대다.t: 덤벙대다 stresses rushing in without thinking; 덜렁대다 stresses forgetfulness.

절충.x: We decided by finding a middle ground between their two opinions.
절충.e: Literally 'break toward the middle': meeting halfway.
절충.t: 절충 blends two ideas into one; 타협 stresses both sides giving something up.

매듭.x: I made a key ring with traditional knotwork.
매듭.e: Native word. The traditional craft of decorative cord knotting is protected as a national intangible cultural heritage (매듭장).
매듭.t: 매듭을 짓다 is 'to tie a knot' and also 'to wrap up (a matter)'; 매듭을 풀다 is 'to untie a knot'. Traditional 매듭 decorates 노리개 (hanbok pendants).

절박하다.t: 절박하다 stresses a person's desperate need; 긴박하다 stresses a tense, fast-moving situation.

유망하다.x: He is a promising young pianist.
유망하다.t: Common phrases: 유망 직종 'promising jobs', 유망 기업 'promising company'.

괴상하다.ex: 그 사람은 괴상한 옷을 입고 나타났어요.
괴상하다.x: That person showed up wearing weird clothes.
괴상하다.e: 괴 means 'weird', as in 괴물 'monster' — monster-level strange.
괴상하다.t: More negative than 이상하다; 기이하다 sounds more neutral and literary.

산성.ex: 산성비는 숲과 건물에 큰 피해를 줍니다.
산성.x: Acid rain causes great damage to forests and buildings.
산성.e: Literally 'acid nature'. -성 = nature, quality: 산성, 가능성.
산성.t: Homonym warning: 산성 (山城) also means 'mountain fortress', as in 남한산성.

사회 안전망.ex: 실업 급여는 중요한 사회 안전망 중 하나예요.
사회 안전망.x: Unemployment benefits are one of the important social safety nets.

해몽.x: I dreamed of a pig, and I'm curious what it means.
해몽.t: A pig dream (돼지꿈) is said to bring money, so people buy lottery tickets. 꿈보다 해몽이 좋다 'the reading beats the dream' teases someone for spinning things positively.

구형.x: The prosecution asked for a 10-year prison sentence for the defendant.
구형.t: Don't confuse 구형 (the prosecutor's demand) with 선고 (the judge's actual sentence); news often reports both.

탈냉전.ex: 탈냉전 이후 국제 질서가 크게 바뀌었어요.
탈냉전.x: The international order changed greatly after the end of the Cold War.
탈냉전.t: Pronounced [탈랭전] — ㄴ after ㄹ becomes ㄹ.

개종.ex: 그는 결혼 후 아내의 종교로 개종했어요.
개종.x: After getting married, he converted to his wife's religion.
개종.t: Pattern: [religion]으로 개종하다, e.g. 불교로 개종하다 (to convert to Buddhism).

발병률.x: Regular exercise lowers the incidence of diabetes.
발병률.e: -률/-율 = rate: written 율 after a vowel or ㄴ (치사율), 률 elsewhere (발병률).

우공이산.ex: 우공이산의 마음으로 매일 조금씩 공부하고 있어요.
우공이산.x: I study a little every day, believing persistence can move mountains.
우공이산.e: From the fable of 'the foolish old man who moved mountains' by digging stubbornly.

파급되다.m: to spread, to ripple out, to have a knock-on effect
파급되다.x: The financial crisis spread across the whole world.
파급되다.e: Literally 'waves reaching' — ripples spreading across water.
파급되다.t: Most common as the noun phrase 파급 효과 (ripple effect).

포착하다.m: to capture, to catch (a moment, signs), to detect
포착하다.x: The photographer captured the moment the child smiled.

무상하다.ex: 세월이 흐르니 인생이 참 무상하게 느껴져요.
무상하다.x: As time goes by, life feels so fleeting.
무상하다.e: Literally 'nothing constant' — the Buddhist idea of impermanence.
무상하다.t: Homonym: 무상 'free of charge', as in 무상 급식 'free school meals', is a different word.

존립.m: existence, survival (of a nation, organization, etc.)
존립.ex: 이번 위기는 회사의 존립을 위협하고 있어요.
존립.x: This crisis is threatening the company's very existence.
존립.t: Pronounced [졸립]: ㄴ becomes ㄹ before ㄹ.

미꾸라지 한 마리가 온 웅덩이를 흐려 놓는다.de: 미꾸라지 한 마리가 온 웅덩이를 흐려 놓는다
미꾸라지 한 마리가 온 웅덩이를 흐려 놓는다.rom: mikkuraji han mariga on ungdeongireul heuryeo nonneunda
미꾸라지 한 마리가 온 웅덩이를 흐려 놓는다.pr: 미꾸라지 한 마리가 온 웅덩이를 흐려 논는다
미꾸라지 한 마리가 온 웅덩이를 흐려 놓는다.forms: 미꾸라지 한 마리가 온 웅덩이를 흐려 놓는다더니 · 미꾸라지 한 마리가 온 웅덩이를 흐린다고
미꾸라지 한 마리가 온 웅덩이를 흐려 놓는다.m: one bad apple spoils the bunch (lit. one loach muddies the whole pond)
미꾸라지 한 마리가 온 웅덩이를 흐려 놓는다.ex: 미꾸라지 한 마리가 온 웅덩이를 흐려 놓는다더니, 한 사람 때문에 분위기가 엉망이에요.
미꾸라지 한 마리가 온 웅덩이를 흐려 놓는다.x: One bad apple spoils the bunch: the whole mood is ruined because of one person.
미꾸라지 한 마리가 온 웅덩이를 흐려 놓는다.e: A single loach wriggling in the mud at the bottom stirs it up and clouds the water of the entire pond.
미꾸라지 한 마리가 온 웅덩이를 흐려 놓는다.t: Also shortened to 미꾸라지 한 마리가 온 웅덩이를 흐린다. The related idiom 물을 흐리다 means 'to spoil the atmosphere of a group.'
nb: 서당 개 삼 년이면 풍월을 읊는다
